purpose: Y-blind pixel-resolution and slice-spacing convergence review over the frozen eight-model SLICE-005 panel

metrics.panel_rank: Spearman rank correlation of eight model values against reference
metrics.top_quartile: top two of eight models, overlap fraction against reference
metrics.runtime: actual seconds and output bytes by configuration; descriptive only

states.strict_converged: fine SRD <=5% and refinement trend passes
states.usable_sensitivity: fine SRD <=10% and refinement trend passes
states.nonmonotonic: fine SRD <=10% but refinement trend fails
states.descriptor_axis_strict: median<=5%, q90<=10%, >=6 strict models, Spearman>=0.90, top2 overlap>=0.80
states.descriptor_axis_usable: median<=10%, q90<=15%, >=6 strict+usable models, Spearman>=0.90, top2 overlap>=0.80

decision_policy.descriptor_reference_retained: both pixel and slice axes are strict or usable
decision_policy.descriptor_reference_hold: either axis is unresolved or nonmonotonic evidence blocks convergence
decision_policy.global_reference_policy: Do not force one universal canonical setting if descriptor families differ
decision_policy.family_claim: Eight-model panel evidence only; do not claim within-family generalization from one or two members
